project_type: Python FastAPI backend for educational AI platform (Syrabit)
test_framework: pytest with anyio, httpx AsyncClient, unittest.mock
verification_instructions: Run pytest for the backend tests. Validate new endpoints with test cases.
environment_constraints: No external network for testing. Use mocked HTTP calls in tests. Cloudflare API credentials (CF_ACCOUNT_ID, CF_API_TOKEN) are in settings but may not be available at test time.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns in the codebase. Use circuit breaker pattern for external calls. Use pydantic models for request/response validation.
key_patterns: CloudflareAIClient singleton pattern in cloudflare_client.py; circuit breaker wrapping external calls; FastAPI router with Pydantic models; auth via get_current_user/get_current_user_optional dependencies; rate limiting via check_rate_limit; Cloudflare API URL pattern: https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/ai/run/{model}
directory_structure: apps/backend/app/ - FastAPI app root; app/api/v1/ - API endpoint routers; app/services/ai/ - AI provider clients; app/core/ - shared utilities (circuit breaker, telemetry); app/config.py - pydantic Settings; tests/ - pytest test files
